Priyanka Banerjee
Digital Marketing Manager | Jaipur, Rajasthan
priyanka.banerjee920@example.com | +91 9686806003 | Immediate joiner

Results-driven digital marketing professional with experience planning and executing SEM and SEO strategies, optimizing paid campaigns, and leveraging analytics to grow acquisition and engagement. Strong cross-functional collaborator with hands-on experience in campaign setup, performance tracking, and content amplification across social channels. Pragmatic problem-solver who translates data into scalable marketing improvements.

Experience

Wipro — Jul 2024 - Mar 2026
Digital Marketing Manager | Remote
- Led SEM campaigns and managed Google Ads accounts, optimizing spend to reduce cost-per-acquisition by 28% while increasing qualified lead volume by 42% over 9 months using keyword refinement and bid adjustments. (SEM, Google Ads)
- Implemented Google Analytics tracking improvements (enhanced e-commerce and goal funnels) that uncovered a 17% drop-off point and enabled UX fixes, improving conversion rate by 12%. (Google Analytics)
- Ran Social Media Marketing initiatives across LinkedIn and Twitter, increasing referral traffic from social channels by 55% and lowering cost-per-click by 20% through creative testing and audience segmentation. (Social Media Marketing)
- Coordinated with product and content teams to align paid search creatives and landing pages, using Confluence to document playbooks and Git for versioning campaign scripts. (Confluence, Git)

Razorpay — Apr 2024 - Jun 2024
Digital Marketing Manager | On-site
- Executed short-term SEM and Google Ads campaigns for a product launch, achieving a 3.6x return on ad spend within the first 6 weeks by prioritizing high-intent keywords and negative keyword lists. (SEM, Google Ads)
- Performed rapid SEO health audits and implemented on-page fixes that improved target landing page rankings from page 3 to page 1 for two priority keywords within 8 weeks. (SEO)
- Created daily performance dashboards in Google Analytics to guide bid adjustments and creative swaps, reducing wasted impressions by 22% and improving click-through-rate by 14%. (Google Analytics)

Quanta Retail — Jun 2022 - Mar 2024
SEO Specialist | Hybrid
- Owned SEO strategy and technical optimizations that increased organic sessions by 78% year-over-year through site-wide content restructuring, schema implementation, and internal linking improvements. (Google Analytics)
- Used Google Analytics to segment user behavior and identify content gaps; launched targeted Social Media Marketing campaigns that grew social referrals by 65% and lifted average session duration by 23%. (Google Analytics, Social Media Marketing)
- Collaborated with engineering using Git and Linux-based deployment workflows to push SEO-related code changes and monitor site performance, improving page load metrics and reducing bounce rate by 19%. (Git, Linux)

Projects
- Conversion Rate Optimization Toolkit — Built a documented CRO playbook in Confluence featuring A/B test templates, hypothesis logs, and analytics dashboards; used across two teams to standardize experiment reporting. (Confluence, Google Analytics)
- Keyword Expansion Script — Developed a Python-based keyword expansion script maintained in Git to generate long-tail keyword lists for Google Ads and SEO campaigns, reducing research time by ~40%. (Git)

Skills
SEO: SEO
Advertising: Google Ads, SEM
Analytics: Google Analytics
Channels: Social Media Marketing
Tools & Dev: Confluence, Git, Linux

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
